summary: Explains that facts are discovered variables about a system, useful for conditionals or inspection, and shows dumping all facts with the setup module.
questions: How do I see all the facts Ansible gathers about my hosts?
What are Ansible facts used for?
Can I filter the setup module output to just some facts?

answer_card.title: Gather facts ad hoc
answer_card.answer_md:
Facts are variables Ansible discovers about a system, used for conditionals or just for information. Show them all:
```bash
ansible all -m ansible.builtin.setup
```
The `setup` module supports filtering to show only certain facts.
